#!/bin/bash
# End-to-end smoke test of the port (see e2e/). Usage: tools/e2e.sh [server|client|all|play]
#   server: headless dedicated server — mixin audit + spawn sub-levels + stay alive 600 ticks
#   client: real game window in a flat world — spawns sub-levels in view, screenshots, quits
#   play:   same scene as client, but the game stays open for manual testing
# Results: e2e/run/<side>/logs/latest.log, screenshots in e2e/run/client/screenshots/
set -uo pipefail
ROOT=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd); cd "$ROOT"
[ -z "${JAVA_HOME:-}" ] && [ -x /usr/libexec/java_home ] && export JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)
MODE=${1:-all}
SRV=e2e/run/server; CLI=e2e/run/client

report() { # <log> <side>
  local log=$1
  echo "== $2 =="
  grep -E "E2E:" "$log" | sed 's/^.*E2E:/  E2E:/' | sort -u | head -30
  local mixin_err; mixin_err=$(grep -cE "Mixin apply.*failed|InvalidInjectionException|InvalidMixinException|MixinTransformerError|Critical injection failure" "$log")
  local exc; exc=$(grep -cE "^\S*(Exception|Error)\b|Exception in|Caused by:" "$log")
  echo "  mixin errors: $mixin_err   exception lines: $exc"
  grep -m5 -E "Mixin apply.*failed|InvalidInjectionException|InvalidMixinException|Critical injection failure|Caused by:" "$log" | cut -c1-300
}

if [ "$MODE" = server ] || [ "$MODE" = all ]; then
  rm -rf "$SRV/world"; mkdir -p "$SRV"
  echo "eula=true" > "$SRV/eula.txt"
  printf 'level-type=minecraft\\:flat\nonline-mode=false\nlevel-name=world\nspawn-protection=0\nmax-tick-time=-1\n' > "$SRV/server.properties"
  ./gradlew :e2e:runServer --console=plain > "$SRV/gradle.log" 2>&1 \
    || { echo "server run failed, see $SRV/gradle.log"; exit 1; }
  report "$SRV/logs/latest.log" server
fi

if [ "$MODE" = client ] || [ "$MODE" = all ] || [ "$MODE" = play ]; then
  # Every run starts from a copy of a clean template world. The server run saves the sub-levels it
  # spawned (in sublevels/, data/ and the plot chunks), so its world can't be reused.
  TEMPLATE=e2e/run/template-world
  if [ ! -d "$TEMPLATE" ]; then
    echo "creating clean template world (one-off server boot without spawning)..."
    rm -rf "$SRV/world"; mkdir -p "$SRV"
    echo "eula=true" > "$SRV/eula.txt"
    printf 'level-type=minecraft\\:flat\nonline-mode=false\nlevel-name=world\nspawn-protection=0\nmax-tick-time=-1\n' > "$SRV/server.properties"
    ./gradlew :e2e:runServer -Pe2ePrepare --console=plain > "$SRV/gradle-template.log" 2>&1 \
      || { echo "template world creation failed, see $SRV/gradle-template.log"; exit 1; }
    cp -r "$SRV/world" "$TEMPLATE"
  fi
  mkdir -p "$CLI/saves" && rm -rf "$CLI/saves/e2e" && cp -r "$TEMPLATE" "$CLI/saves/e2e"
  # keep simulating while the window is unfocused; skip onboarding screens
  printf 'pauseOnLostFocus:false\nonboardAccessibility:false\ntutorialStep:none\nskipMultiplayerWarning:true\njoinedFirstServer:true\n' > "$CLI/options.txt"
  if [ "$MODE" = play ]; then
    ./gradlew :e2e:runClient -Pe2ePlay --console=plain > "$CLI/gradle.log" 2>&1
    exit 0
  fi
  rm -rf "$CLI/screenshots"
  ./gradlew :e2e:runClient --console=plain > "$CLI/gradle.log" 2>&1 \
    || { echo "client run failed, see $CLI/gradle.log"; exit 1; }
  report "$CLI/logs/latest.log" client
  ls "$CLI/screenshots" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/  screenshot: /'
fi

_Last updated: 2026-10-17 (S8a fixed). Keep this file current: update the status tables when you claim, finish or

## Goal

Run **Create Aeronautics** (the [Simulated Project](https://github.com/Creators-of-Aeronautics/Simulated-Project):
Simulated + Aeronautics) on **Minecraft 1.21.11 with Fabric**. Upstream only supports NeoForge 1.21.1, and none of its
dependencies existed for 1.21.11, so we port the whole stack ourselves:

| Layer | Upstream (1.21.1 NeoForge) | Here (1.21.11 Fabric) |
|---|---|---|
| Create | Create 6.0.10 | **[Create Fly](https://github.com/ZurrTum/Create-Fly) 1.21.11-6.0.9-5** (existing Fabric port; used as a dependency, not modified) |
| Physics | Sable 2.0.6 (+ Rust/Rapier natives) | **`sable/`**: ported, natives reused as-is |
| Rendering/network lib | Veil 4.3.2 | **replaced** by an in-repo shim, `dev.ryanhcode.sable.veillite` |
| Content | Simulated + Aeronautics 1.3.2 | **`simulated/`, `aeronautics/`** (Phase 2) |
| Offroad | Offroad | out of scope for now |

- Simulated/Aeronautics **code is MIT**, but their **assets are All Rights Reserved**.

## Getting started (new contributor)

Requirements: JDK 21, git, ~16 GB RAM, macOS or Linux.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/KiraKami-dev/minecraft-create-fly && cd minecraft-create-fly
git checkout integration                  # the working trunk (see Workflow)
tools/setup-reference.sh                  # ~5-10 min: decompiles MC 1.21.11 + 1.21.1, clones upstream sources into reference/
./gradlew :sable:compileJava              # should be 0 errors
tools/e2e.sh server                       # headless smoke test (see Testing)
```

Then read **`PORTING.md`**: the porting rules, the 1.21.1 → 1.21.11 API cheat sheet, and where everything is.

`reference/` (gitignored) holds what you need to port anything:
`mc-1.21.11` (target, decompiled), `mc-1.21.1` (original), `fabric-api-1.21.11`, `sable-1.21.1`,
`simulated-1.21.1` (including the NeoForge modules), `veil-1.21.1`, `create-fly-1.21.11`.
The fastest way to port a call: find it in `mc-1.21.1`, then diff against the same class in `mc-1.21.11`.

## Workflow

- **`integration`** is the trunk. Branch from it, and merge back with a PR or a no-ff merge once your branch compiles.
- **`main`** only moves when a milestone passes (compiles + e2e). Don't commit to it directly.
- **One task per branch** (`<area>-<short-name>`). Claim a task by putting your name in the table below and pushing

- **Never commit the `reference` folder or a `reference` symlink.** A tracked `reference` deletes everyone's local

- Before merging: `./gradlew :sable:compileJava` (and the Phase 2 modules once they're in the build),

- Shared files that conflict often: `sable.accesswidener` (it's a list, so take the union and re-validate) and

- Commit messages: imperative, describe the change. No AI attribution trailers.

`tools/e2e.sh [server|client|all]` drives the dev-only harness in `e2e/`:
- **server**: boots a dedicated 1.21.11 server, runs a **mixin audit** (forces every mixin to apply), spawns
